title: Software Engineer, Agents
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We’re a team focusing on shipping AI agents for scientists, helping them automate toil and accelerate breakthroughs. Our agents automate many parts of scientific work that take hours to weeks today: designing experiments, capturing data, analyzing data, and writing complex reports. As an engineer on the team, you’ll build these agents end-to-end, from designing the agent architecture to shipping intuitive interfaces for the agents within our scientific applications. It’s early days for AI agents, both at Benchling and in the industry at large. We’ll rapidly iterate with customers and change directions quickly, figuring out new patterns for how we develop and go to market. We’ll win if we stay curious and obsess over our customers.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Build end-to-end AI agents, prototyping and productionizing systems that automate scientific work, from experiment design to data analysis and reporting.

- Work directly with customers to ideate use cases, gather feedback, build evaluations, and onboard scientific teams.

- Engineer across the stack, from developing new LLM-powered primitives to shipping intuitive user interfaces inside Benchling’s applications.

- Continuously improve our agent platform, contributing to frameworks, tooling, and infrastructure that accelerate future agent development.

- Shape how we build AI at Benchling, driving experimentation, contributing to technical direction, and helping evolve our engineering and product development practices as the field matures.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, building and maintaining production systems.

- Experience across the stack, comfort working with backend systems (Python or similar languages) and modern frontend frameworks (React or equivalent).

- Strong product sense, with the ability to iterate quickly and refine solutions based on user feedback and data.

- Curiosity and excitement about LLMs and AI agents, and a desire to shape how they can transform scientific research.

- Collaborative mindset, able to work closely with engineers, product managers, and scientists to bring new ideas to life.

- Desire to work in a fast-paced environment, where priorities can shift and rapid experimentation is encouraged.

- Interest in learning about biotechnology (no prior knowledge required, just a willingness to learn and adapt).

This is an in-person team in San Francisco built around collaborating in the office in a fast-paced environment. We’re in the office Monday through Friday.

À propos d'Ingeno
Ingeno est une firme de services professionnels basée au Québec, spécialisée dans le développement de solutions logicielles sur mesure et de solutions en intelligence artificielle, avec un focus sur les secteurs manufacturier et de la défense. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la conception, la construction et la mise à l'échelle de systèmes critiques, en combinant une expertise technique pointue à une approche pragmatique axée sur la livraison et la valeur ajoutée.
Aperçu du poste
L'architecte principal(e) partage son temps entre le leadership technique sur les mandats clients les plus complexes et la standardisation des pratiques, des processus et de l'orientation technique à l'échelle de l'entreprise. À ce titre, ce rôle exerce une influence directe sur les décisions technologiques et l'orientation technique d'Ingeno.
Responsabilités
L'architecte principal(e) combine le leadership technique sur les mandats clients les plus complexes avec la responsabilité de standardiser les pratiques, les processus et l'orientation technique à l'échelle de l'entreprise, couvrant les domaines suivants :
1. Livraison client

• Agir à titre d'architecte principal(e) sur les mandats clients les plus complexes et à plus haut risque d'Ingeno

• Servir de point d'escalade technique pour les équipes de livraison confrontées à des enjeux d'architecture

• Diriger l'architecture de solution durant les phases de découverte stratégique et de conception de solution pour les comptes stratégiques

• Effectuer la révision des risques techniques et l'approbation des énoncés de travail (SOW) dépassant un seuil de complexité défini

2. Cycle de développement logiciel

• Détenir et faire évoluer en continu le cadre de développement en cinq phases d'Ingeno (découverte stratégique, conception de solution, planification de livraison, développement itératif, déploiement et transition)

• Diriger la révision d'architecture pour les projets dépassant un seuil de taille ou de complexité défini

• Détenir le cadre de mesure de performance et d'indicateurs par phase; s'assurer que les leçons tirées des rétrospectives et post-mortems se traduisent en améliorations concrètes des processus

3. Estimation

• Standardiser la méthodologie d'estimation à travers les équipes de livraison

• Réviser et approuver les estimations dépassant un seuil défini avant leur communication aux clients

4. Utilisation de l'IA

• Définir les stratégies d'utilisation de l'IA à l'interne et pour les projets clients

• Optimiser les processus de développement produit et logiciel en faisant levier sur l’IA

• Définir les garde-fous et les bonnes pratiques pour une utilisation sécuritaire et responsable de l'IA, incluant la gestion des données client sensibles

• Établir les standards d'intégration et d'interopérabilité pour les composants d'IA (LLM, RAG, bases de données vectorielles, modèles de ML), tant à l'interne que dans les solutions clients

• Superviser les décisions de type « bâtir ou acheter » pour les outils et l'infrastructure d'IA

• Maintenir des standards d'utilisation de l'IA cohérents à travers l'organisation

5. Stratégie technologique

• Établir, en collaboration avec la haute direction, les stratégies technologiques de l'entreprise et participer à leur implantation
6. Développement des compétences

• Contribuer à l'évolution de l'échelle de compétences techniques (la propriété demeure celle des chefs d'équipe et de la direction)
7. Soutien aux ventes

• Fournir, au besoin, un appui à la solution technique et à la révision des risques des SOW pour les opportunités complexes

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, en génie logiciel ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente

• 12 années ou plus d'expérience en génie logiciel, incluant une portion significative en architecture

title: Deployed Architect, Professional Services (Austin)
description:
ABOUT US

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Deployed Architect to join our Professional Services team. You'll work directly with enterprise customers to design, deploy, and optimize production-grade AI infrastructure and agent systems. You'll be responsible for architecting scalable, secure infrastructure deployments and building reliable, well-evaluated agent applications that solve real business problems.

This role combines software development, infrastructure/platform engineering, and customer-facing skills. You'll work on everything from Kubernetes cluster design to multi-agent system architecture, requiring deep technical expertise across both infrastructure and agent engineering domains.

This role offers direct impact on customer success, the opportunity to shape best practices, and work with cutting-edge AI technology. You'll join a collaborative team environment with a strong engineering culture.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

title: Backend Engineer, Partnerships
description:
ABOUT US
Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.
For more information, visit xsolla.com.
 
ABOUT YOU
We are looking for a Backend Engineer at junior level to join our APAC Partnerships team in Vladivostok, working alongside our HQ Integration Management and Engineering teams. Your job is to make partnerships technically real: turning an inbound partnerships inquiry into a working integration, generating and serving the affiliate and referral links that Traffic Source Partners use, and making sure the traffic those links carry lands correctly in our Web Shops and is attributed all the way through to a purchase.
You will write the backend that sits between a partner and our commerce platform - link generation, click and conversion tracking, attribution pass-through, postbacks, and the reporting endpoints that feed partner payouts. You will also build the internal tooling that lets the Partnerships and Customer Success teams onboard partners and reconcile payouts without hand-editing spreadsheets.
This is an entry-level engineering role with genuine product surface area. Recent graduates and career-changers with a strong project portfolio are welcome. If you like small, well-scoped systems that other people depend on daily, and you want to learn commerce, attribution, and payments engineering from a team that runs it at global scale, we would love to hear from you.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Build partner integrations
Build and maintain backend services that power Traffic Source partnerships: affiliate and referral link generation, click and conversion tracking, attribution parameter pass-through, server-to-server postbacks and webhooks, and partner-facing reporting endpoints.
Take new partnerships inquiries from intake through to production - clarify the requirement with the Partnerships and BD teams, write the technical spec, implement, test, and deploy.
Integrate affiliate links with Xsolla Web Shops so partner-driven traffic is tracked end to end and attributed correctly at checkout.
Read a partner's API documentation and build against it; where a partner needs to build against us, document our side clearly and support their integration.
Tooling & data
Build internal tooling and scripts for partner onboarding, bulk link generation, performance data extraction, and payout reconciliation reporting used by the Customer Success and Partnerships teams.
Investigate and resolve attribution and tracking discrepancies together with Analytics and Customer Success - missing conversions, duplicate events, broken parameters, timing mismatches.
Add logging, metrics, and alerting so integration failures are caught by us rather than reported by a partner.
Ways of working
Write and maintain API documentation and integration guides for partners and internal stakeholders.
Participate in code review, write tests, and work within existing CI/CD pipelines and Git workflows.
Work with the HQ Engineering and Integration Management teams on standards and architecture; escalate design decisions early rather than working around them.
Collaborate closely with the Partnerships Designer on the frontend surfaces your integrations power, and with Customer Success on the payout data your services produce.
Track work in Jira and keep technical documentation current in Conflue

• Provide controls support for process-critical campus systems, including cooling plants, liquid-cooling loops, electrical distribution, and fire / emergency shutdown (ESOP); protect plant stability during recovery

• 2+ years of hands-on experience with mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, or hydraulic systems in a manufacturing, industrial, or critical-facility environment; OR associate's degree in a technical field (controls technology, mechatronics, automation, or equivalent)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Strong working knowledge of NFPA 70 (National Electrical Code), NFPA 70E, NFPA 79, and UL 508A

• Create the operational blueprint for how loans flow through our proprietary, AI-powered software platform, ensuring speed, quality, and regulatory compliance.

• Previously worked full-time as a residential mortgage loan processor.

• Experience processing for independent mortgage brokers (not exclusively retail lenders or bank mortgage departments).

• Startup-ready mindset: adaptable, resourceful, fast-moving, and positive under pressure.

About Atria:
The Atria Health Institute is a membership-based primary and specialty health care practice with a focus on prevention and longevity. We bring together a multidisciplinary team of renowned physicians to provide proactive, preventive, and precision-based care for Atria members and their families. All care, including primary care, advanced screening and diagnostics, urgent care, specialty care, 24/7 home visits, and imaging is included in members’ annual fee.
Our mission is to make healthspan and lifespan equal for all by translating science into medicine in real-time, all while bringing humanity back into health care. Delivering such robust, personalized, and preventive health care is complex and requires a team-wide dedication to excellence.
After successfully opening our flagship Institute in New York in 2022 and expanding to South Florida in 2024, we are now bringing the Atria experience to the West Coast with the launch of our Los Angeles Institute in late spring 2026.
Atria Health is seeking a Software Engineer for our DevOps team to help build and operate the infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and observability that the rest of engineering relies on every day.
This is an individual contributor role focused on:

• Building and maintaining cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and automation that let product teams ship safely and quickly

• Keeping our systems reliable and observable, and helping the team respond when things break

• Reducing operational toil through tooling, automation, and good documentation

You'll work alongside the Tech Lead and other DevOps engineers to improve and maintain infrastructure-as-code, improve our build and release process, and strengthen our monitoring and security posture. You'll partner with the Platform, Data Engineering, and domain product teams (Clinical Experience, Member Experience, and Care Delivery) to understand their needs and make their path to production smoother. You'll care deeply about both how we build and what we achieve, while working to accelerate the work of our client teams.
Key Responsibilities
Infrastructure & Automation

• Build and maintain cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform using Terraform, following the patterns and standards set by the team.

• Implement and improve CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions to make deployments fast, safe, and repeatable.

• Automate manual and repetitive operational work with scripts and tooling to reduce toil across engineering.

Reliability & Observability

• Instrument services and infrastructure with meaningful monitoring, dashboards, and alerting in Datadog, and help cut down on alert noise.

• Participate in the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, and work to ensure uptime for our applications.

• Define and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for our core infrastructure and build systems.

Developer Enablement

• Support product engineering teams with deployment pipelines, environment issues, and build troubleshooting.

• Help maintain preview and staging environments, including reliable data sync, masking, and cleanup routines so teams can test against realistic data.

• Improve developer experience through better tooling, clear runbooks, and documentation.

Quality & Collaboration

• Write well-tested, well-reviewed infrastructure code, and participate in design reviews and RFCs with a pragmatic, operations-focused perspective.

• Design systems and changes to meet the team’s goals.

• Give and receive thoughtful code reviews, and share knowledge through pairing and documentation.

Tech Stack

• Languages: TypeScript, Python, Bash

• Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, Terraform, Cloudflare

• CI/CD: GitHub Actions

• Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis

• Observability & Incident Management: Datadog, Sentry, Rootly

• Integrations: Athena EMR, wearable platforms, third-party healthcare APIs

Requirements
Core Experience

• ~3 - 4 years of professional experience in DevOps, SRE, infrastruc

title: Backend Engineer, Growth Platform
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Growth Platform is how DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo market as one. We're building a single AI-native marketing platform across all three brands, unifying customer data, intelligence, and execution so every partner team can launch faster, personalize better, learn continuously, and scale wins across brands. The scope is global, the ambition is large, and we're only getting started.

We're hiring backend engineers who want to be at the front line of what engineering looks like in the age of AI.

💡 Why Growth Platform?

• An AI-first team by design. We don't use AI as a productivity add-on - we treat agentic coding as a core engineering discipline. We expect our engineers to build with AI agents, to challenge what's possible when the human-in-the-loop is a multiplier rather than a bottleneck, and to push the boundaries of what a focused team can ship.

• Real ownership, real impact. Growth Platform powers marketing across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo, reaching millions of users daily. You'll own features end-to-end, from the idea through production, and see your work matter at scale across three brands.

• Cross-org engineering at the frontier. We work across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo to unify customer data, intelligence, and execution into one platform. This is engineering at the intersection of product ambition, marketing at scale, and international complexity.

• Leverage those compounds. Everything we ship is leverage: unify the data, sharpen the intelligence, and streamline execution so every partner marketing team can launch faster, personalize better, and learn continuously. When we get it right, wins scale across all three brands instead of being rebuilt one at a time.

🤖 AI-First Engineering - What This Means Here

We're building teams at the forefront of agentic coding. This isn't about using Copilot to autocomplete boilerplate. We mean engineers who:

• Design workflows where AI agents handle entire task loops, from spec to PR.

• Think in terms of orchestration: what does a human review, what does the agent own?

• Build internal tooling and abstractions that make AI-assisted development faster and more reliable for the whole team.

• Stay curious and ahead of the curve - trying new models, agents, and tools as they emerge, and forming strong opinions about what's genuinely useful vs. hype.

If you find yourself naturally asking "can an agent do this?" before reaching for the keyboard, you'll fit right in.

🔍 What We're Looking For Across all roles

• Strong engineering fundamentals - you've built and shipped software that runs at scale, and you understand what that entails: testing, observability, reliability, and maintainability.

• Genuine enthusiasm for AI-first development. You use AI tools daily and have formed real opinions about how to get the most out of them.

• Ownership mentality: you drive projects forward, communicate clearly across teams and time zones, and don't wait to be told what to do.

• Collaborative instincts - Growth Platform sits at the intersection of backend, data, ML, and product. Cross-functional work is the norm, not the exception.

🙌 About You

• You've built and shipped real software - products, platforms, APIs, apps - and you know what it takes to keep things runni

title: Senior Power Generation Technical Specialist - FULLY REMOTE
description:
Senior Power Generation Technical Specialist

Health Insurance: 100% employer-paid for you + your dependents
Location: Remote

Schedule: Remote

$130,000-$142,000 in compensation with base salary + employer-paid family health coverage alone, before PTO, retirement and other benefits.

LionHeart is a veteran-owned power generation company seeking a Senior Power Generation Technical Specialist to help solve our most difficult electrical and mechanical field problems.

You’ll work alongside Electrical Engineers and highly experienced Field Service Veterans, supporting technicians working on mission-critical generators, ATS equipment, switchgear, controls and paralleling systems.

What You’ll Do

• Serve as a senior escalation point for difficult technical cases

• Work directly with Field Service Engineers during active troubleshooting

• Diagnose complex generator, engine, controls, ATS, switchgear and paralleling issues

• Provide real-time support using schematics, fault histories, controller data, photos, video and remote diagnostic tools

• Interpret one-lines, wiring diagrams, sequences of operation and technical documentation

• Own escalated cases through resolution and coordinate with OEMs, vendors and engineering resources

• Identify root causes, recurring failures and troubleshooting trends

• Coach technicians and strengthen technical capability across the field organization

• Occasionally provide onsite support for highly complex troubleshooting or commissioning

• Strictly follow and enforce OSHA, NFPA 70E, and all applicable safety regulations for electrical safe work practices.

Technical Background

We’re looking for someone with strong experience across the mechanical and electrical sides of power generation, including:

• Diesel and gaseous generators

•
Commercial and Industrial engines

• Electronic engine control, fuel systems, cooling systems, exhaust systems, and all associated controls

• Generator alternators and excitation systems

• AC/DC electrical systems (LV and MV)

•
Generator Controls

• CAT, Cummins, Kohler (Relkoh), Generac, Basler, ComAp, Deep Sea, DEIF

• Automatic transfer switch controls

• ASCO, ABB, GE Zenith, Russelelectric

• Low- and medium-voltage paralleling and distribution switchgear

• Paralleling Controls (synchronization, voltage control, governor control, load management)

•
PLCs and industrial controls

• GE Fanuc 90-30, RX3i, hardware (and Proficy PME Software)

• Schneider Modicon Quantum, Premium, TSX, M340, etc. hardware (and EcoStruxure software).

• Electrical one-lines, risers, schematics, wiring diagrams, and ladder logic

• Auxiliary equipment integration (communications including ModBus RTU, TCP/IP).

General knowledge including:

• Circuit breakers and trip units

•
ANSI Protective relays

• Basler, Schweitzer, ABB

• Power distribution and circuit protection

• Station Batteries and charging systems

Qualifications

• 5+ years of power generation, industrial electrical, controls, engine or related field-service experience preferred

• Strong hands-on troubleshooting background

• Ability to diagnose complex failures logically and methodically

• Ability to guide experienced technicians through difficult troubleshooting remotely

• Strong communication and technical documentation skills

• Multi-OEM experience is a plus

• Technical or engineering degree preferred, but advanced field experience is valuable

• Commonsense problem-solving mindset

• Ability to clearly and effectively communicate with customers.

Compensation & Benefits

Base Salary: $115,000-$125,000

LionHeart provides 100% employer-paid health insurance for you and your dependents, valued at approximately $22,000 per year.

That means zero monthly family health insurance premium deducted from your paycheck.

Additional benefits include:

• Paid Time Off

• Paid Holidays

title: Revenue Strategy & Analytics Director
description:
Hover helps people design, improve, and protect the properties they love. With proprietary AI built on over a decade of real property data, Hover answers age-old questions like “What will it look like?” and “What will it cost?” Homeowners, contractors, and insurance professionals rely on Hover to get fully measured, accurate, and interactive 3D models of any property - all from a smartphone scan in minutes.

At Hover, we’re driven by curiosity, purpose, and a shared commitment to serving our customers, communities, and each other. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives and are proud to cultivate an inclusive, high-performance culture that inspires growth, accountability, and excellence. Backed by leading investors like Google Ventures and Menlo Ventures, and trusted by industry leaders including Travelers, State Farm, and Nationwide - we’re redefining how people understand and interact with their spaces.

Why Hover wants you 

Our sales-led business is growing faster than the systems that measure it. We need one person who can build a complete, trustworthy view of that business and then use it to change how we run. You'll design the instrumentation, automate the reporting that today takes people days, and hand the board, our CEO, our CFO, and our CRO a single source they can act on. Then you'll go after the gaps those numbers expose.

You will contribute by

Building Hover's sales analytics and strategy function from a partial foundation into a system the whole company relies on. You'll instrument the metrics that describe our sales-led business, then automate the work that surrounds them: the CRO's weekly metrics pack, board deck preparation, and our annual revenue planning models. description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Pricing Strategy team is part of Stripe's Product Marketing organization and is responsible for how Stripe prices its products. Our work is highly cross-functional and we partner closely with Product Management, Finance, and Sales to tackle some of Stripe's most visible and commercially impactful decisions. We're looking for someone who can blend financial analysis, strategic thinking, stakeholder engagement, and operational rigor to help us price new products and evaluate their pricing performance as the products evolve.

What you’ll do

You will support the development and execution of pricing and packaging strategies across Stripe’s existing and upcoming products. Working at the intersection of Product development, Go-to-Market, and financial planning, you will analyze pricing questions, develop recommendations, and help cross-functional teams move from insight to execution.

You will also play an important role in strengthening how the Pricing Strategy team operates - bringing structure and consistency to recurring processes, improving visibility into the team’s work, and identifying opportunities to help the team scale and increase impact.

Responsibilities

• Build an understanding of the value Stripe’s products deliver to users and how they compare with relevant alternatives

• Drive alignment across Finance, Legal, Product, and Go-to-Market stakeholders on pricing proposals and bring them to execution

• Leverage internal and research data to build financial models to evaluate the impact of pricing changes on revenue, margin, and user behavior

• Contribute to scalable tools and processes that help the Pricing Strategy team work more consistently and efficiently

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 3-5 years of relevant experience in pricing, strategy, operations, finance, product, or management consulting, ideally involving pricing, go-to-market, product recommendations, or other strategic business questions

• Experience conducting qualitative and quantitative user research on product needs and value perceptions, as well as market research and competitive benchmarking

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, and a willingness to proactively work with functions across the company

Preferred qualifications

• Demonstrated ability to ask the right questions and to use sound business judgment when collaborating with a wide-range of stakeholders

• Knowledge of the payments ecosystem and value chain, knowledge of software and AI industry pricing model and trends

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. We're looking for data scientists with a passion for analyzing data, building machine learning and statistical models, and running experiments to drive impact. Our work is broad and varied, influencing how our products work (e.g., understanding user needs, preventing fraud, or optimizing charge flows), how our business works (forecasting key outcomes, managing liquidity, and quantifying risk exposure), how our go-to-market motions operate (designing growth experiments, optimizing marketing investments, refining sales processes, and estimating causal effects), and everything in between. • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations

• Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities

 Preferred qualifications

• Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company

• Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing

• Strong statistical knowledge

• Working knowledge of Python

• Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs, MBRs

title: Associate Scientist/Scientist I, Translational Biology
description:
Your Impact at LILA

We are seeking a driven and scientifically rigorous Associate Scientist with deep flow cytometry and cross-species tissue handling expertise to join our translational biology team. In this role, flow cytometry and ex vivo tissue processing are your core disciplines: you will independently isolate and process cells from liver, spleen, and whole blood across mouse, rat, NHP, and human samples, and execute complex multi-parameter panels to interrogate LNP uptake, cellular delivery, immune activation, and phenotypic response across in vitro and ex vivo models. Working closely with team leadership, you will help develop and refine assay strategy, contribute to experimental design, and complement this with a broader immunoassay and cell biology toolkit to evaluate lipid nanoparticle (LNP) delivery and therapeutic function. Beyond hands-on execution, you will interpret and contextualize data to inform project direction and partner with leadership to advance key scientific questions. You will help shape LILA's high-throughput, data-rich discovery workflows at the intersection of biology, automation, and AI, while mentoring junior team members on flow and tissue-processing technique and best practices.

What You'll Be Building

• Serve as a flow cytometry subject-matter expert: independently execute high-dimensional, multi-parameter panels to assess cell viability, LNP uptake, transfection/expression, immune activation, and marker phenotyping across primary and immortalized cell types; partner with leadership on panel design and assay development strategy.

• Own the full flow workflow: fluorophore selection and spectral considerations, compensation/unmixing, instrument setup and QC, acquisition, and rigorous analysis and interpretation in FlowJo (or spectral/conventional platform software); collaborate with leadership to develop and optimize new panels.

• Serve as a tissue processing and cell isolation expert: independently isolate viable single-cell suspensions and immune populations from liver, spleen, and whole blood across mouse, rat, NHP, and human samples, including perfusion, mechanical/enzymatic dissociation, density-gradient separation (PBMC/leukocyte), and RBC lysis; work with leadership to establish and optimize new cross-species workflows.

• Prepare and process tissues from in vitro and in vivo studies for downstream analysis (flow, ELISA, multiplex, qPCR), including homogenization, protein/RNA extraction, and lysate preparation; ensure high viability and yield for cross-species flow readouts.

• Drive flow-based readouts for LNP and delivery system performance across species and tissues, translating complex cytometry data into actionable insights that shape project direction.

• Run in vitro assays evaluating LNP and delivery system performance across readouts including IncuCyte, uptake, expression, knockdown, cytotoxicity, and innate immune activation.

• Execute high-throughput and plate-based screening experiments, including plate-based (high-throughput) flow, liquid handling, and data collection; contribute to screening design in partnership with leadership and the automation team.

• Oversee sample collection, aliquoting, labeling, and storage; ensure biorepository integrity and robust sample tracking across species and study types.

• Assist with development of multiplex immunoassays (MSD, Luminex, ELLA) for cytokine profiling, protein quantification, and immunogenicity assessment; support panel qualification, troubleshooting, and SOP authoring in collaboration with leadership.

• Analyze, interpret, and present experimental data at team and cross-functional meetings; translate results into actionable next steps and contribute to experimental strategy.

• Maintain detailed laboratory notebooks and electronic records with high data integrity; mentor junior scientists on flow cytometry technique, tissue processing/cell isolation, panel design, documentation, and troubleshooting.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Lendable's Payments team transacts money for our UK Loans, AutoLend (motor finance) and Zable (credit card) products: disbursing loans, collecting repayments, refunding customers and reconciling everything against our banking providers.

We're bringing in a recent graduate on a 6-month contract to strengthen the controls around our daily loan funding and to add capacity across payments and partner indemnity recovery. A large part of our AutoLend lending is originated through third-party partners, and you'll own the daily process that verifies funds are flowing correctly through that chain before we release the next day's payments. You'll run that control every day, then use the remaining time to help us make it faster, better evidenced and, where possible, automated.

This is a hands-on operational role and a strong first job in fintech. You don't need finance experience; we'll teach you the payments side. You do need to be numerate, methodical, quick to learn and comfortable being the last line of defence before money leaves the building.

Daily funding controls (core responsibility)

- Run the daily pre-release checks on partner funding: gather payment evidence from our third-party partners, reconcile it to our disbursal records, and confirm that yesterday's funds reached the intended recipients before today's payments are approved.

- Hold, query or escalate anything that is missing, late or doesn't reconcile, and document the reason clearly so commercial, operations and risk colleagues can act on it.

- Keep a full audit trail of every check, exception and release decision so the control is evidenced for internal review and audit.

- Spot the trends in partner behaviour and payment timing that warrant a closer look, and raise them early.

- Run periodic verification of partner and payee bank details, and re-verify whenever a partner asks us to change where we pay them.

- Work with the Payments Manager to onboard more partners onto the control, and to turn the manual check into matching rules, scripts and monitoring that surface only the exceptions.

Payments and finance operations

- Support day-to-day payment operations: cash allocation of incoming repayments, refunds and returned payments, and reconciliation against our bank and payment providers.

title: Engineering Manager - Research Engineering
description:
Flow Traders is strengthening leadership across its Research Engineering department and is hiring an Engineering Manager. Research Engineers conduct applied research jointly with quants to deliver our trading models and research platform. As the firm scales, the quality of engineering management has become one of the most important factors in how well our teams grow, retain talent, and deliver - and this role exists to raise that bar.

Engineering Managers are accountable for the planning and people side of the organisation - project deliveries, growth, performance, culture and hiring - and partner with technical leads who own architecture, technical direction, and hands-on execution. The two work in close partnership; neither succeeds without the other.

You will be measured on the engineers you develop and the outcomes your team delivers. You will spend the large majority of your time leading people and managing delivery.

 

What you will do:

•
Own the roadmap: manage priorities, planning, and sequencing of the work in line with company goals.

•
Develop your engineers: own career planning, promotions, coaching, and structured, continuous performance management.

•
Plan and build the team: lead hiring, headcount planning, and resource allocation in line with the team's roadmap and the firm's priorities.

•
Cultivate a healthy team: actively manage culture, morale, and productivity, and address conflict early and constructively.

•
Lead with rhythm: hold regular one-on-ones, give clear and timely feedback, and invest in team building.

•
Translate technical and business requirements into clear delivery plans, identifying dependencies with other teams and risks up front.

•
Act as the liaison between Engineering, Trading, and Quant teams to design and roll out new products.

•
Drive delivery predictability: track progress against plan, manage risk and scope trade-offs, and report status clearly to stakeholders.

•
Continuously improve delivery processes and team velocity.

•
Ensure alignment: keep your team's work connected to organisational goals and delivery timelines, collaborating closely with Tech Leads and Staff Engineers on research and technical direction.

 

What you need to succeed:

•
Strong people-leadership skills: coaching, feedback, conflict resolution, and building an environment in which engineers thrive

•
Strong project management skills: experience building roadmaps, sequencing work, managing dependencies and risk, and driving delivery predictability in a fast-moving environment.

•
A technical or research background sufficient to earn the respect of the engineers you manage and to engage credibly in technical discussions.

•
Demonstrated experience leading, growing, and managing the performance of applied researchers and software engineers.

•
A track record of delivering applied research through a team, balancing scope, quality, and timelines.

•
Sound judgment in hiring and developing talent.

•
Excellent communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including experience managing cross-functional stakeholders (e.g. Trading, Quant).

 

Flow Traders does not accept unsolicited resumes from any professional staffing or search firms. All resumes, and any other information identifying potential candidates, submitted to any employee at Flow Traders via-email, the Internet or directly without a valid and signed search agreement will be deemed free to contact by Flow Traders without any restrictions and no placement fee of any kind will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Flow Traders

title: Data Scientist
description:
This is a remote position.
About Monaire
Monaire is building the infrastructure layer for intelligent commercial HVAC. We combine on-device sensors, smart thermostats, and machine-learning systems to automate control, surface real operational insight, and materially reduce energy waste at scale. This is not offline modeling or notebook ML. Models run in production, interact with physical systems, and must be observable, debuggable, and correct. The platform spans edge devices, cloud services, streaming pipelines, control logic, and ML inference.

Engineers here work on:

• Data ingestion and streaming at scale from heterogeneous hardware

• Low-latency decision pipelines and control loops

• ML systems that survive missing data, drift, and adversarial real-world conditions

• Infrastructure for model deployment, monitoring, and rollback

• Apps and services that customers depend on to run their buildings every day

The market is large, broken, and technically underserved. We’re scaling the system and need engineers who care about correctness, performance, and ownership - people who want to build infrastructure that actually controls the physical world, not just dashboards that look good in demos.

Role Overview

As a Data Scientist / Senior Data Scientist , you will play a critical role in building production-grade ML systems that drive real-world outcomes-energy efficiency, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, and operational intelligence for HVAC/R systems.

You will work closely with backend engineers, product managers, and domain experts to translate raw sensor data into reliable models that power customer-facing features and internal decision-making.

This role requires someone who can think long-term architecturally , while delivering short-term, measurable impact in a fast-moving startup environment.

What You'll Do:

• Scale ML systems for 5X growth-optimize batch processing, database queries, and model inference

• Design ML models for time-series data, anomaly detection, and predictive maintenance

• Optimize production systems:

• Database optimization (MongoDB): indexes, connection pooling, 3-5X performance improvement

• Batch processing: parallel processing, async operations, memory management

• Model optimization:

• NLP & LLM: enhance conversational AI bots with intelligent query generation

• Build monitoring systems: real-time dashboards, SLA tracking, automated scaling

Requirements

Must-Have Skills

• 2+ years hands-on data science/ML experience

• Strong Python (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn)

• Deep learning: TensorFlow, Keras, or PyTorch

• MongoDB: Query optimization, indexing, aggregation pipelines

• Database optimization: Index design, query tuning

• Batch processing: Parallel processing (multiprocessing/async)

• Time-series data, anomaly detection, statistical modeling

• Strong CS fundamentals and debugging skills

Nice-to-Have Skills

• MLOps tools, Lambda optimization, caching (Redis/ElastiCache)

• Monitoring: Grafana, Prometheus

• NLP/LLM: Prompt engineering, conversational AI

• IoT/sensor data experience, startup experience

• AWS: Lambda, S3, CloudWatch, ElastiCache/Redis

• Docker, SQL, Flask API development

Qualifications

Bachelor's/Master's/PhD in CS, IT, Applied Math, Statistics, or related field

Benefits

• Competitive salary + equity with meaningful ownership

• Comprehensive health insurance (self, spouse, children, and parents)

• Remote-first, flexible work culture

• Opportunity to work on high-impact systems with climate and sustainability impact

• Strong emphasis on engineering excellence, ownership, and growth

• ​ Collaborative, inclusive, and low-ego team culture
